name: kb
description: Multi-layer cache knowledge base with configurable data root. L3 (sources) -> L2 (wiki) -> L1 (AGENTS.md) compilation pipeline with progressive disclosure, task tracking, research docs, session finishing, and health checks.

interface.longDescription: Multi-layer local knowledge base workflows for source capture, wiki compilation, task tracking, research recall, session finishing, and health checks. Supports a configurable KB data root for global plugin installs.
defaultPrompt: Set up a knowledge base in this repo.
Compile my sources into the wiki.
Finish this session and capture useful context.
